title: SourcesIndex
description: Per-source health metadata published at /sources/index.json. Lets the app's Sources tab report honest per-source status instead of inferring the source list from whichever events happen to be in the feed.

last_run_at.description: Null when the source has never completed a successful run.

event_count.description: Count in this source's own file, before cross-source dedup and before the client's date filtering. Will legitimately exceed what the app displays. Zero when the source has never published.

url.description: Path to this source's own file, relative to the feed root. Null when the source has never published and no such file exists.
